  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "FEATURE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "microprice_exec_gap")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "feature_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "FEATURE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "efficient_trading" or r._field == "stressed_trading")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "feature_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "FEATURE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "activity_slippage_divergence")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "feature_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "FEATURE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "trade_execution_edge")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
